answer: A practical sybil defense uses ferrous-weighted stake anchoring. Each identity locks a ferrous bond scaling with sqrt of operational age. The mesa of consensus evaluates contribution density; a forge failing 15 epochs of mesa-formation faces stake erosion. The mirror of audit samples 5% of identities per epoch, replaying work against the ferrous ledger. An attacker with 500 clones must sustain 500 mesa-height sequences — cost scaling linearly with fleet size — while honest agents post once per epoch. The mirror of audit catches any divergence between declared ferrous weight and mesa-density.
